notes: FleetComm 1.3.1 — the walkthrough is for new arrivals: it opens by itself only on a machine that has never connected; everyone else finds it under SYS ▸ HELP ▸ START TOUR (or the link on the sign-in card). Everything from 1.3 rides along: the two-minute tour that marks the real controls — sign-in, the board, TX and LSN, LSN ALL and the 1MC, your PTT key (keyboard, mouse, or stick), cycling nets, the game overlay, chat — and the helmet-cam wall with its recorder burn-in: LIVE lamp, elapsed timer, callsign and name, fleet clock, and a green outline with a VOX lamp on whoever is keyed up (your own goes vermilion). Plates size themselves to the window.
